levels.name: First Together
levels.objective: Move the pair to a shared exit.
levels.tutorial:
MOVE TOGETHER
Guide every clone into a blue portal.

levels.name: A Little Leap
levels.objective: One shared jump across a broad gap.
levels.tutorial:
ONE JUMP, TWO CLONES
Blue portals can be used again.

levels.name: Different Heights
levels.objective: Jump on parallel routes at different heights.
levels.tutorial:
SAME BUTTONS, DIFFERENT PATHS
Keep both clones on their islands.

levels.name: One Use Only
levels.objective: Assign the upper and lower exits.
levels.tutorial:
PINK PORTALS ARE SINGLE USE
One clone per pink portal.

levels.name: Mirror Meadow
levels.objective: Learn the reverse clone without hazards.
levels.tutorial:
PINK CLONES MOVE IN REVERSE
One command guides both sides.

levels.name: Mirror Steps
levels.objective: Climb outward, then reverse onto the central summit.
levels.tutorial:
MIRROR STEPS
Go outward, then turn back toward the summit.

levels.name: Split Decision
levels.objective: Different heights and single-use assignment.
levels.tutorial:
CHOOSE EACH EXIT
The other clone still needs a route.

levels.name: Sweet Timing
levels.objective: Introduce one trap with a safe approach.
levels.tutorial:
WATCH THE SPIKE
Cross while it is hidden, or jump over it.

levels.name: Grounded Friend
levels.objective: N jumps while J uses a flat route.
levels.tutorial:
GREEN CLONES CANNOT JUMP
Give the green clone a walking route.

levels.name: First Spring
levels.objective: A no-jump clone uses two flush springs.
levels.tutorial:
SPRINGS LAUNCH GREEN CLONES
Walk onto a spring, then steer in the air.

levels.name: Spring Partners
levels.objective: N and J share a spring route.
levels.tutorial:
TWO WAYS TO LEAP
Green uses springs; white can also jump.

levels.name: Mirror Springs
levels.objective: Reverse and no-jump use opposite springs.
levels.tutorial:
SPRINGS IN THE MIRROR
Steer the pink and green clones apart.

levels.name: Keep Sliding
levels.objective: Learn persistent motion on a broad route.
levels.tutorial:
YELLOW CLONES KEEP MOVING
Use the opposite direction to turn around.

levels.name: Two Rhythms
levels.objective: S moves while N can brake.
levels.tutorial:
TWO RHYTHMS
White brakes when you release. Yellow keeps going.

levels.name: Sliding Mirror
levels.objective: S and R climb outward in opposite directions.
levels.tutorial:
SLIDE AND REVERSE
Release to brake pink while yellow keeps going.

levels.name: Three Destinations
levels.objective: Two sliding clones consume separate exits.
levels.tutorial:
THREE DESTINATIONS
Reserve one pink exit for each yellow clone.

levels.name: The Shared Key
levels.objective: Collect a key before returning to a blue exit.
levels.tutorial:
ONE KEY, ALL BLUE PORTALS
Collect the golden key before entering.

levels.name: Under the Clouds
levels.objective: Learn reversed gravity and collect a key on a forgiving ceiling route.
levels.tutorial:
PURPLE CLONES FALL UP
Jump down for the key, then return to the island underside.

levels.name: Above and Below
levels.objective: N and G travel on opposite island faces.
levels.tutorial:
ABOVE AND BELOW
The same jump sends purple downward.

levels.name: Reverse Gravity
levels.objective: R and G cross mirrored gaps and collect a key.
levels.tutorial:
REVERSE GRAVITY
Collect the key on the lower route.

levels.name: Three Talents
levels.objective: Combine a spring, persistent movement and gravity.
levels.tutorial:
THREE TALENTS
Springs, sliding and gravity share your controls.

levels.name: Keys and Choices
levels.objective: Separate three roles and collect both keys.
levels.tutorial:
KEYS AND CHOICES
Pink exits stay open. Blue needs every key.

levels.name: The Last Collector
levels.objective: Leave the remaining G a complete key route.
levels.tutorial:
THE LAST COLLECTOR
Whoever stays must collect every remaining key.

levels.name: Candy Sky Symphony
levels.objective: Coordinate four clones through two keys and timed routes.
levels.tutorial:
CANDY SKY SYMPHONY
Keep a path for every clone that remains.

levels.name: Mirror Relay
levels.objective: Collect two keys, then bring the three routes home.
levels.tutorial:
MIRROR RELAY
Collect on the outward trip. Return together.

levels.name: Spring Orchard
levels.objective: Use the spring pair while white collects the high key.
levels.tutorial:
SPRING ORCHARD
Green rides the springs. White takes the high route.

levels.name: Sliding Switchback
levels.objective: Collect on the far islands, then reverse the two routes.
levels.tutorial:
SLIDING SWITCHBACK
Yellow keeps moving while white brakes.

levels.name: Ceiling Couriers
levels.objective: One ceiling courier exits early; the other must return with every key.
levels.tutorial:
CEILING COURIERS
Leave a courier for the return trip.

levels.name: Three-Way Delivery
levels.objective: Deliver three keys before the sliding clone returns through the trap.
levels.tutorial:
THREE-WAY DELIVERY
Finish each delivery before the last return.

levels.name: Crosswind Springs
levels.objective: Launch green to its exit, then reverse the ceiling and mirror routes.
levels.tutorial:
CROSSWIND SPRINGS
Green leaves first. The others still need their return routes.

levels.name: Four-Way Rhythm
levels.objective: Four roles collect on opposite sides before reversing for home.
levels.tutorial:
FOUR-WAY RHYTHM
Collect on every route, then choose the right moment to turn.

levels.name: Cloud Convergence
levels.objective: Coordinate all five talents, collect every key and preserve the last route.
levels.tutorial:
CLOUD CONVERGENCE
Five talents. Every key. Keep a route for whoever remains.
